project.title: A PURPLE PREMIERE
project.description: A Purple Premiere is one of the cupsleeve events that I have personally organized in Coffee Spot Ermin Garcia. A cupsleeve event is one where fans gather at a cafe decorated with pictures and mementos of their favorite idols and get to know each other while enjoying a program full of games, activities, and raffle.

project.title: BL WONDERLAND
project.description: Set up a booth in Ayala Malls the 30th along with other fanclubs in collaboration with Gemini Creations to engage fans in fun activities and games.

project.title: OHM KRITTY MEOW MEOW
project.description: I led a fundraising for stray cats in Araneta Center Cubao, collected monetary and in-kind donations from both local and international fan sponsors, collaborated with Cats of Araneta City to do a feeding day together with volunteers.
